messages:
Maya Chen: quick heads up — streaming calls from SDK 1.5.0 are getting dropped by runtime when the client sends the new 'stream_start' event header. Repro on canary. Request: keep cluster pinned to 1.4.2 for prod and only run 1.5.0 in isolated canary until we patch runtime.

Jules Park: Can you paste repro steps? Is this a decode error or header parse?

Maya Chen: Steps:
```
curl -X POST https://canary.api.redwoodai.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Client-Version: 1.5.0" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello","stream":true}' -v
```
Response: socket closes, no partial events. On 1.4.2 client it streams fine. Logs show "unknown event: stream_start" in runtime.

Samir Patel: Hmm. We added strict-event parsing in runtime v2.3 to avoid weird clients. We can add a tolerant branch to accept unknown events and log a warning. That would be a small patch (3 lines) — low risk.

Kevin Park: We already have a pinlist PR for prod. +1 to pin prod to 1.4.2. Can we allow 1.5.0 on canary?

Maya Chen: Yes — canary only for now. I ran full e2e streaming suite on canary and saw failures.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] scheduled: update pinlist to lock SDK version 1.4.2 on production; target window: 2024-11-05T15:12:00Z — ETA ~3m.

Jules Park: Samir — if you can land the tolerant-parsing patch by EOD we can unpin next week. Otherwise we'll keep the pin.

Samir Patel: I'll open PR with test. ETA 4 hours.

Ryan O'Neill: I'll prepare release note + upgrade guide: call out streaming header change and recommended runtime minimum. Also add migration snippet to SDK docs.

Maya Chen: tagging @oncall-bot in case canary shows regression overnight.

oncall-bot: Incident monitor: canary streaming error rate spiked to 4.1% at 15:04 UTC; baseline 0.2%. Alert threshold passed.

Kevin Park: Rolling back canary to pinned client 1.4.2 for the affected pool now?

Maya Chen: Don't need full rollback — just change canary label to route old clients for tests. I updated the canary config.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] completed: pinlist update applied to production (1.4.2 pinned). canary left on 1.5.0 for narrow tests.

Jules Park: Thanks. Once Samir's PR lands and we validate on canary, we'll schedule unpin.

Samir Patel: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/3421 — patch + unit tests.

Maya Chen: Verified PR on canary; streaming restored. Good to unpin next maintenance window. :tada:

deploy-bot: scheduled unpin canary -> prod window: 2024-11-12T02:00:00Z (maintenance). Please add release notes.

Ryan O'Neill: Draft ready — will post RFC in #eng-releases later today.

Maya Chen: awesome. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
